page.title: Pitch Score 3D
page.aria: Animated reel: a synthetic pitcher as a 3D mannequin, one card per phase with reference ranges, then a pitch score with phase bars
page.intro_html: A 3D mannequin driven by joint positions, read the way a phone-to-3D swing app reads a swing: one card per phase, green or amber against a range, one cue, and a score. This version runs on the scripted Pitch Lab pitcher at 120 fps, analysed by Motion Studio's own biomech.py. The pitcher is synthetic, so the low scores say something about the script, not about a person.
page.notes_html:
What this is not

  • Not a real pitcher: the skeleton is ten hand-made poses blended together.
  • Not a validated score: the ranges are published group values, and a single number hides which phase matters.

reel.tagline: Joints in. Mannequin, ranges and a score out.
